<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 580" width="500" height="580">
  <!-- White background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="500" height="580" fill="white" />

  <g transform="translate(150, 40)" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
    <!-- Cell Wall (Outer boundary) -->
    <rect x="40" y="10" width="140" height="230" rx="40" ry="40" fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" />

    <!-- Cell Membrane (Inner boundary) -->
    <rect x="44" y="14" width="132" height="222" rx="36" ry="36" fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,2" />

    <!-- Cytoplasm (Light shading) -->
    <rect x="45" y="15" width="130" height="220" rx="35" ry="35" fill="#f0f0f0" />

    <!-- Large Central Vacuole -->
    <rect x="65" y="75" width="90" height="140" rx="20" ry="20" fill="white" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5" />

    <!-- Nucleus (pressed to one side near top) -->
    <ellipse cx="110" cy="50" rx="22" ry="16" fill="white" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <!-- Nucleolus -->
    <circle cx="115" cy="48" r="6" fill="black" />

    <!-- Chloroplasts (about 10 small oval shapes around the edges) -->
    <!-- Top left -->
    <ellipse cx="65" cy="45" rx="8" ry="5" fill="black" transform="rotate(-20, 65, 45)" />
    <!-- Top right -->
    <ellipse cx="150" cy="40" rx="8" ry="5" fill="black" transform="rotate(30, 150, 40)" />
    <!-- Upper left side -->
    <ellipse cx="55" cy="85" rx="8" ry="5" fill="black" transform="rotate(70, 55, 85)" />
    <!-- Upper right side -->
    <ellipse cx="165" cy="80" rx="8" ry="5" fill="black" transform="rotate(-60, 165, 80)" />
    <!-- Mid left -->
    <ellipse cx="53" cy="130" rx="8" ry="5" fill="black" transform="rotate(85, 53, 130)" />
    <!-- Mid right -->
    <ellipse cx="167" cy="135" rx="8" ry="5" fill="black" transform="rotate(-75, 167, 135)" />
    <!-- Lower left -->
    <ellipse cx="58" cy="180" rx="8" ry="5" fill="black" transform="rotate(45, 58, 180)" />
    <!-- Lower right -->
    <ellipse cx="162" cy="185" rx="8" ry="5" fill="black" transform="rotate(-30, 162, 185)" />
    <!-- Bottom left -->
    <ellipse cx="80" cy="220" rx="8" ry="5" fill="black" transform="rotate(10, 80, 220)" />
    <!-- Bottom right -->
    <ellipse cx="140" cy="222" rx="8" ry="5" fill="black" transform="rotate(-15, 140, 222)" />

    <!-- Label Lines and Letters -->
    <!-- A: Cell wall (pointing to outer line on left) -->
    <line x1="40" y1="80" x2="5" y2="80" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.2" />
    <text x="0" y="84" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" text-anchor="end">A</text>

    <!-- B: Cell membrane (pointing to inner line on left, just below A) -->
    <line x1="44" y1="105" x2="5" y2="125" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.2" />
    <text x="0" y="129" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" text-anchor="end">B</text>

    <!-- C: Chloroplast (pointing to one chloroplast on right) -->
    <ellipse cx="165" cy="135" rx="8" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="red" stroke-width="0.5" /> <!-- invisible anchor -->
    <line x1="167" y1="135" x2="215" y2="135" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.2" />
    <text x="222" y="140" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" text-anchor="start">C</text>

    <!-- D: Nucleus (pointing to nucleus at top) -->
    <line x1="110" y1="34" x2="215" y2="34" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.2" />
    <text x="222" y="39" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" text-anchor="start">D</text>

    <!-- E: Vacuole (pointing to central vacuole) -->
    <line x1="110" y1="160" x2="215" y2="190" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.2" />
    <text x="222" y="195" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" text-anchor="start">E</text>

  </g>

  <!-- Caption -->
  <text x="250" y="325" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 1.1</text>
</svg>
